final_text:
My best guess is that the employee would alert the manager and, if no permission could be registered today, **extend the box anyway**, then release the rest of the batch on time.

The booked collection, pending request and irreplaceable contents make this an unusually compelling case, while the warehouse cost is relatively small. The employee would nevertheless be knowingly breaching an explicit rule; tomorrow’s approval would not retroactively authorise the change.

That prediction is uncertain: another employee might follow the manager’s instruction, particularly given the audit and the risk of discipline.
